subject: planner: Adjust cost for semijoin and apply (#66786)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent for planner-only changes. The commit (1) refactors outer-child ExpectedCnt derivation for ordered IndexJoin/Apply via `calcOuterExpectedCnt`, applying `tidb_opt_ordering_index_selectivity_ratio` only when ordering is required; (2) adjusts `LogicalApply.DeriveStats` row-count for `SemiJoin`/`AntiSemiJoin` using `cost.SelectionFactor` (aligning Apply semijoin cardinality with LogicalJoin); and (3) increases cost-model-v2 IndexJoin probe cost for (anti-)semi join types by scaling with `probeRowsOne` to reflect batched lookup over-reading vs per-row short-circuit behavior. Test/testdata updates are consistent with these estimate/cost-trace changes. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or session/protocol issues found.
